```text
Upgrade screen: recovered authored cards and hit regions
Retained menu: fresh capture → blur history → source-over reversal
Frame ownership: effects → Main/world → backgrounds → later menu
```

Combines layers 3–5 after #129 and #128 were folded top-down. Remaining stack: #125 ← #126 ← #127. This PR targets the deployment-controls layer.

Imports the authored upgrade layout and text metrics; renders native/mock card artwork, live previews and independent Edit targets. Keeps the menu bitmap and source clock through child creator/viewer visits, applies immediate avatar placement before closing, and prepares fresh Pixi/HUD/flash paint at capture. Fixed recipient cohorts separate paused gameplay from attached artwork and preserve explicit background stop/resume commands.

- **Before:** approximate upgrade cards, immediate dismissal and stale capture/frame ordering.
  **After:** authored geometry, retained bitmap/alpha history and source-backed stage ownership.

**Door:** two-way

Changes upgrade presentation, menu lifetime, capture and frame/input/background ownership.
